svg.aria-label: Sorting algorithms visual guide: comparison sorts versus counting sort, and seven variant cards.
svg.text: Six algorithms here only ever ask “is A bigger than B?” — that question alone caps them at O(n log n).
The seventh sidesteps the question entirely. Code lives in 00-sorting-algorithms/*.js.
Comparison sorts vs. the one exception
log₂(n!) ≈ n log n is the proven floor for anything that only compares —
counting sort isn't faster at the same game, it's playing a different one.
Six comparison shapes, one non-comparison exception

g.text: Every full pass without a swap
array IS the heap — placed, heap shrinks

Sidesteps the O(n log n) floor
